publisher: Historic England via GOV.UK API Catalogue
dataset: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) API catalogue
data_date: not stated; catalogue states data updated daily
evidence_slice: GOV.UK API Catalogue entry 'National Heritage List for England (NHLE)' identifies the NHLE as the official, up-to-date register of nationally protected historic buildings and sites in England, states that the data contains points and polygons for Listed Buildings, is updated daily, is released under the Open Government Licence, and publishes the Historic England ArcGIS FeatureServer endpoint. The selected catalogue page does not expose a record-level Exeter feature or polygon-coordinate payload.

field_evidence.footprint: The API Catalogue confirms that NHLE contains Listed Building polygons and publishes the official FeatureServer endpoint, but this catalogue window exposes no record-level Exeter polygon coordinates.
field_evidence.type_use: This API Catalogue window is dataset/API metadata only and contains no record-bound Exeter building type/use payload.
field_evidence.coverage: Catalogue states the NHLE covers England and is updated daily.
